note: Nextmv (YC Winter 2020) was a Philadelphia-based DecisionOps/optimization-AI startup founded 2019 by Carolyn Mooney and Ryan O'Neil. FICO announced it had acquired Nextmv on 2026-05-19 (company blog: 'Nextmv is now part of FICO'); the product and pricing pages remain live under Nextmv branding, with the docs footer now crediting Fair Isaac Corporation. No funding-round amounts, investor names, or revenue figures were ever publicly disclosed by the company or in press coverage found during this research; card's own pricing is all quote/contact-sales, consistent with a now-enterprise (FICO-owned) go-to-market.
